parsed.rationale: Both participating records reside in test targets: `Shared/AppServices/Tests/AppServicesTests/NowPlayingServiceTests.swift` and `Shared/Artwork/Tests/ArtworkTests/ArtworkServiceTests.swift`. Both carry the name `MockArtworkService`, making them mock fixtures used within their respective test suites. Even though the Jaccard similarity is 0.75, the restraint rule requires no-action whenever any participating record is a test fixture, and here both records are test-only mocks. Consolidating them would couple two independent test packages through a shared mock, which is undesirable and contrary to the isolation each test suite requires.
